blocks.html: Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) is the total cost a company incurs to acquire a new customer, including marketing, advertising, sales expenses, and related operational costs. It is calculated by dividing total acquisition costs by the number of new customers gained during a specific period. In simple terms, CAC shows how much it costs your business to convert a prospect into a paying customer.
